reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per activation event on 14 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS prev_ts
  FROM activation_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-14 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-15 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name,
  CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
FROM gaps

solver.query: SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session FROM activation_events WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-14 00:00:00+00' AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-15 00:00:00+00' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name)
